capabilities: Render ### HH:mm headings as timeline posts in Live Preview and Reading view
Add entries via a daily-timeline composer code block
Post to today's daily note from a command or ribbon icon
Configure display name, handle, avatar, and daily notes folder and date format
disambiguation: Not a calendar or cross-note timeline view; it styles and speeds up entry writing inside a single daily note.
problem: Daily notes have no fast way to add timestamped entries or view them as a chronological feed without breaking plain Markdown.

relations.evidence: Leave empty to use the core Daily notes plugin's settings.

summary: Renders timestamped ### HH:mm entries in daily notes as a Twitter-style timeline and adds a composer for posting new entries.
